verdict_reason: Every linked test exists and sits in a PR-set diff, and scenario-level coverage holds through the fit links, but several per-link strength full claims overstate what their own assertions and probes prove (REQ-017 client unit links, and the 004-D code-alone fallback).

todos.issue: Client unit tests are marked strength full for REQ-017 scenarios whose Thens they cannot witness. A mocked fetch in jsdom cannot show a server outcome: :555 (017-F) checks only that the form submits natively, not 'shows the results it lists without JavaScript'. :564 (017-G) checks the held submit carries chosen=[], not 'refused with Select a commodity'. :574 (017-H) checks the second post carries no chosen, not 'only the species ticked after clearing is chosen' after save. :593 (017-J) never checks 'the species is still chosen'. :602 (017-K) checks a class name (app-multi-select-search--enhanced), not that no Update selected control is shown, since the CSS hides it. The notes 'covered by the same probe as the fit test above' borrow the fit test's red probe, which proves the shared module line matters, not that the unit asserts cover every Then. Scenario-level coverage stays full through the fit links, so the derived values hold, but the per-link strength overstates.
todos.fix: Must: a link is strength full only when its own assertions prove every Then of the scenario, and its own probe went red. One way: set the five unit links at :555, :564, :574, :593 and :602 to partial, with notes saying which Then each checks (for example 'checks the native submit with the pressed button; not the rendered results').

todos.issue: SCN-COMMODITY-SELECT-004-D is coverage full, but no single link proves both its clauses. :128 'Should name the commodity with its code in brackets' (full) asserts only legendHtmlFor('0102','') === 'Cow (0102)', which is the THEN. :130, the fit test 'heads each commodity with its name and code' (full, borrowing that probe), checks only CATTLE_HEADING, which is also the THEN. The AND clause, 'a group whose commodity has no known name is headed by its code alone', is witnessed only by :129 'Should show the code alone for a commodity with no name', marked partial and 'not separately inverted'. The fallback branch in legendHtmlFor has no red probe, so the full claim on the scenario rests on links that each cover half of it.
todos.fix: Must: SCN-COMMODITY-SELECT-004-D is full only when a probed full link covers the code-alone fallback, otherwise it reads partial. One way: invert the no-name fallback in labels.js, see 'Should show the code alone for a commodity with no name' go red, restore it, then mark that link full with the probe in its notes. Either that or mark the two name-and-code links partial ('checks the name with code; not the code-alone fallback').
